headline_item.title_zh: 中期选举AI广告投入超一亿美元
headline_item.title_en: Wesleyan Media Project: political campaigns spent ~$187M on ~300 AI-generated or AI-enhanced ads in the midterms; 90% of tracked AI ads were for GOP candidates (Loreben Tuquero/Poynter)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国中期选举期间，竞选团队斥资1.87亿美元投放约300条AI生成或增强广告，其中90%来自共和党阵营
headline_item.event_summary_en: During the recent US midterms, political campaigns invested approximately $187 million into 300 AI-generated or AI-enhanced advertisements. Research indicates that 90% of these tracked AI ads were deployed by Republican candidates, signaling that generative AI has become a primary tool for mass political persuasion.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国各政治竞选团队（主要是共和党）在美国中期选举竞选活动：投入1.87亿美元制作300条AI生成或增强广告
【起因与机理】利用低成本、高影响力的AI内容在选战中争夺选民注意力与控制叙事权
【关键数据与实测】1.87亿美元换取300条AI增强素材。
【观点态度】共和党阵营几乎垄断了当前的AI政治营销份额。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] US political campaigns (primarily GOP) (Midterm elections): Spent $187M on 300 AI-generated or enhanced ads
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To weaponize AI for cost-effective mass persuasion and narrative control
[Perspective & Impact] The GOP dominated the deployment of AI in political messaging.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 看来AI不仅能写代码，还能帮政客“造梦”。当90%的AI广告都出自一家之手时，这已经不是技术赋能，而是量产“数字幻觉”的军备竞赛，建议选民下次看广告时先挂个防诈骗插件。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: It seems AI isn't just for writing code—it’s now a dream factory for politicians. When 90% of these ads come from one camp, it’s not just 'tech empowerment' but an arms race for mass-produced digital illusions; voters might want to install an anti-scam filter before the next rally.

headlines.title_zh: Grok开发的AI应用致海量数据泄露
headlines.title_en: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
headlines.event_summary_zh: 安全机构发现95%通过Grok生成的应用未设访问权限，导致患者医疗数据及企业内部销售文档被公开
headlines.event_summary_en: Security researchers discovered over 35,000 apps built via Grok are publicly accessible without authentication. Due to misleading publish settings and predictable URL structures, sensitive data including patient records and internal business pipelines are currently exposed to anyone with a link.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】AI助手Grok的用户及开发方xAI在Grok.me平台及相关子域名：94.7%的生成应用无需登录即可访问，导致隐私数据泄露
【起因与机理】发布对话框默认预选了“拥有链接者均可访问”且域名规律易被探测
【关键数据与实测】超过94%的Grok生成应用无访问控制。
【观点态度】xAI内部机密文档也在泄露名单中。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Grok users and xAI (Grok.me platform): 94.7% of AI-generated apps are accessible without login, causing massive data leaks
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Default 'anyone with the link' setting and predictable subdomain naming
[Key Metrics] Over 94% of Grok apps lack access control.
[Perspective & Impact] xAI internal docs are among the leaked files.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 这就是所谓的‘AI让开发门槛归零’，顺便也把企业的防线给归零了。默认勾选‘所有人可见’这操作，简直是给黑客发入场券，马斯克这波属于是靠一己之力给全行业演示了什么叫负分安全架构。
headlines.industry_impact_en: So this is what happens when you lower the barrier to coding to zero; you also lower your security standards to zero. Defaulting to 'public access' isn't a feature, it's a gift-wrapped data breach for any bored script kiddie.

headlines.title_zh: 独立游戏界因AI代码使用掀起混战
headlines.title_en: Game developer House House confirms using AI during Big Walk's final development, sparking an intense debate among Independent Games Festival judges and jurors (Luke Plunkett/Aftermath)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 独立游戏开发商House House承认在《Big Walk》最后开发阶段使用了AI修复Bug，引发独立游戏节评委团的激烈争议
headlines.event_summary_en: Independent studio House House utilized LLMs to troubleshoot technical bugs during the final development phase of 'Big Walk'. This disclosure ignited intense debate among IGF jurors regarding the ethical boundaries of AI in game development, despite the developer's claim that AI-generated code accounts for less than 0.1% of the final product.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】开发商House House与独立游戏节（IGF）评委团在独立游戏节评审过程及社交媒体讨论区：开发商承认使用AI修复Bug，引发评委对独立游戏纯粹性的质疑与争议
【起因与机理】游戏圈对生成式AI介入创作流程的敏感度激增，导致对“独立”定义的防卫性反应
【关键数据与实测】开发商强调AI仅占总代码量0.1%以求自证。
【观点态度】行为在独立游戏节评审圈引发极大争议。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] House House and IGF jurors: Admission of using AI for bug fixing, sparking debates over the 'indie' standard
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rising sensitivity to generative AI in creative workflows
[Key Metrics] Developer emphasizes the less than 0.1% usage to justify the action.
[Perspective & Impact] Revelation triggers fierce debate among IGF jurors.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 这就像在纯手工匠人的聚会上掏出了一台吸尘器，虽然只用了0.1%的力气，却足以让那群执着于“纯手工”的评委们原地破防。大厂用AI叫效率，独立工作室用AI叫“背叛信仰”，看来游戏圈的鄙视链又多了个新的坐标系。
headlines.industry_impact_en: It’s like pulling out a vacuum at a purist’s artisanal workshop; even if it only accounts for 0.1% of the work, the purists will still call it a betrayal of the craft. Big studios call it 'efficiency,' but for indies, it’s a new trigger for the ever-spinning industry moral compass.

人们应该始终掌控未来。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
